notes.title: Survival tips in a harsh world
notes.content:
What would you do if you were alone in a dark woods? Scared? Maybe. What would you be more afraid of: loneliness or constant need? The harsh world challenges you. Will you accept it? Can you resist? Yeah ... So many questions and so few answers ...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38519070/30117a6423462544dc2a99d3a6b9a861ea41eb8e.jpg[/img]
 
Try to experience this feeling in the game “Woods Part 1”, you will face an ordeal that not everyone can master. Many give up halfway, many get confused in their own world, like blind people, looking in themselves for something that was never in them. Some people manage to create an image: an imaginary, calming idea that bestows vitality. But rarely does anyone take the blow of fate face to face. Rarely does anyone fight to the very end. That's how we people are. We all have weaknesses. But that's not a reason to give up, is it?
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38519070/9d2e75b4a4aa91ea9dfe6fe0573edfaafa073e76.jpg[/img]

The harsh winter will envelop you in the inevitable cold. Keep warm. Warm not only your body, but also your mind. Learn to think in extreme situations, learn to think, tinker, look for a way out at any cost. Discover the new universe of Woods Part 1, challenge yourself!

notes.title: The style of the game
notes.content:
Style is a pretty important aspect of any VR game. The immersive atmosphere provides a wide range of opportunities for interaction with the player. We understand this moment and want to get the most out of VR technology, to make the game as penetrating into the player's mind as possible. The atmosphere of a mysterious woods will be intertwined with an equally mysterious story. You will feel it ...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38519070/9d2e75b4a4aa91ea9dfe6fe0573edfaafa073e76.jpg[/img]
 
VR games take a lot of design effort. This technology erases the familiar gameplay features inherent in conventional computer games. Since the immersion in the game becomes very deep, it is necessary to design the player's movements as plausibly as possible, his interaction with the game world, without causing any contradictions. Objects near the player should be great detailed. The atmosphere of the game, sounds, movement, interaction - all these elements require a lot of effort.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38519070/c6941dfbbc16264efbd1d7c1c0797959d7ca31fd.jpg[/img]
 
But despite all the difficulties, the game is becoming livelier, more and more fulfilling every day. Soon you will touch the exciting world of story-driven VR game.

notes.title: Forest campfire atmosphere with VR
notes.content:
Evening gatherings around the fire in the woods with a guitar. What could be better? Sit and listen to music, warm up and enjoy the unsurpassed beauty of nature. Complete pacification and peace. What else do you need to relax after a hard day?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38519070/9d5c4d1da75a83776be4dfc422f8769d7b06b151.png[/img]
 
Thinking over the concept and the main idea of the game, we took into account the fact that players certainly need a relaxing gameplay element. Constant stress during harsh survival, the search for vital items is extremely difficult. Therefore, we give our players the opportunity to take a break from all this daily hustle and bustle and enjoy sitting around the fire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38519070/7df296945254ca607785a20f81d9d8218902719d.gif[/img]
 
The stylized atmosphere, unusual and colorful landscapes, as well as the story of David contribute to immersion in the gaming world. You will want to come back here again and again! The game offers not only hard everyday life of survival, but also relaxing elements. «Woods Part 1» is more than just a VR game. First of all, it is the soul, heart and feelings. Plunge into this mysterious world, feel all that we have invested in this project.

notes.title: Chapter (or part) 1
notes.content:
What would you like to get from this game? Great story? Beautiful, filled dialogues? Or maybe you are interested in immersive VR gameplay? If so, then it's time for us to tell you what awaits you in the first chapter of the game "WOODS - Part 1". Agree, the first impression often leaves the brightest mark in our memory. Therefore, we should always be very sensitive to creating this impression. And we did our best.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38519070/5f7ef20380621b0b3083f5cc253cea45c6475449.jpg[/img] 
 
You will find yourself in a new life, in a new personality, immersed in the yet unknown universe. But don't worry, we'll teach you the basics, give you the tools you need to start your journey. Fighting the bad weather alone, you will be saturated with the thoughts of the protagonist. Try to take his place, feel how the main character is intertwined with your personality. After all, this game is not just a gameplay, it’s also a conversation with oneself ...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38519070/7df296945254ca607785a20f81d9d8218902719d.gif[/img]
 
David is the name of the main character. Starting the game, you will find yourself in a mysterious woods full of secrets. Don’t be afraid that you won’t understand something, the fragments of David's memory will open the curtain for you and show you the reason why he ended up here. A survival story awaits you. You will adapt to the world around you, in parallel more and more imbued with the story, get to know David, with his thoughts and feelings. Survive, discover the secret of this world, help David in this difficult fight!

notes.title: The main idea of the game
notes.content:
The game "WOODS - Part 1" will consist of three chapters (camps), describing the world in different colors, slowly immersing the player in the exciting atmosphere of the new universe. Gradually you will learn more and more and discover the history of events that changed this world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38519070/c54f58f28aa62ebe4fd4b2c817d3b79aeff1e010.jpg[/img]
 
Yes, you will have to try, because you will live in the woods, in the mysterious cradle of nature. Players will have to face a cold, indifferent winter… Survive by splitting logs and starting a fire all alone. Fishing, cooking, tinkering. Balance hard work and rest. The goal of the game is to stay alive and understand how the main character found himself in such a situation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38519070/1c48999df38e0545e725404dfd2e0e8b9760cc9d.jpg[/img]
 
Virtual reality will plunge you into an amazing atmosphere, you will find yourself alone with the unsurpassed beauty of nature. The player will directly interact with the objects of this world, necessary for his survival. In moments of exhaustion, you can play the guitar while sitting by a warm fire. But do not forget about the story, because you are here for a reason ...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38519070/b7ca8d6b0e1053f3358556020b7f71e0a24a7d05.gif[/img]

notes.title: Story of the game
notes.content:
Hello everyone, fans and lovers of VR games!

Before fully presenting and showing the game, I want to briefly tell you how the idea to create a game came about.

The idea for this game came about in March of last year during a really rough, long winter. I had to chop wood outside in a snowstorm. As I was doing so, the idea for this game suddenly came to mind. The spooky setting of a cold, dark woods seemed like the perfect environment for a new virtual reality survival game. Since I really love to write, I am engaged in photography, first of all I decided to take photographs and small sketches, which you can see here in the announcement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38519070/103c2125cc0f2f3c4172c9aacfc754217b32833c.jpg[/img]

Then it all turned into something more global and interesting - the desire to create a video game. I decided that the future project will be in VR, since virtual reality allows you to fully immerse yourself in the game world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38519070/24131d2bc69b8a40f20f6ef82deb7d6953447373.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38519070/24131d2bc69b8a40f20f6ef82deb7d6953447373.png[/img]

After that, I made a sketch of the intended game world - a large island with trees. Every day new ideas appeared, the desire to make an atmospheric stylized game about survival in the woods only grew.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38519070/eaa061643aab63786569e01d16d148bfc84946bb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38519070/3757e0023077443ce37b1a7633f08fd9658ec1ab.jpg[/img]

This is just the beginning. Very soon I will share with you other details regarding the project. Wait for new announcements!
